title: Steven Greenstreet's one-night visit

tellings.quote: >> one night. He spent one night on the ranch, and he came in obviously with confirmation bias.

plain: A man named Steven Greenstreet visited Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, and spent just one night there. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells Michels this and says Greenstreet "came in obviously with confirmation bias." Fugal's point is that a single night is too short to judge what goes on at the ranch.
